comment: Map areas and routes for the Farsta level. Each area is a bbox [south, west, north, east]: roads 'all' fetches every drivable street, 'main' only bigger roads (motorway to unclassified, with slip roads). The origin of the local metre grid is the test centre, found in the OSM data by its address; fallback is used only if the address is missing (Farsta district centre, from Wikipedia). Routes: a name and waypoints. They start and end at the test centre. A waypoint is [lat, lon], or an object: near [lat, lon] (approximate is fine), and optionally road (name or ref, e.g. '73' or 'Lissmavägen'), heading (compass degrees, picks the carriageway), kind ('roundabout' or 'junction') and radius (metres to search, default 1500 with road or kind, 60 otherwise).

routes.name: Nynäsvägen south, Huddinge exit, Lissmavägen
routes.note: Road 73 towards Nynäshamn, exit towards Huddinge at Länna, out along Lissmavägen (road 605, country road), back on road 73 north to Farsta. From students' accounts on korkortonline.se.

routes.name: Nynäsvägen to Vega
routes.note: Road 73 south to Vega, Haninge: roundabouts and the 40 road past Bauhaus, then back on road 73. From students' accounts on korkortonline.se.

routes.name: Nynäsvägen to Norrby
routes.note: Road 73 south to Norrby, next to Vega in Haninge, then back on road 73.

routes.name: Nynäsvägen towards Stockholm, back through Hökarängen
routes.note: Road 73 north towards Stockholm, then back south through the residential streets of Hökarängen.
